stations.title: Shop server
stations.text: Has the stock as a file now.

captions: The racks moved online, and the stock now lives on the shop's server.
Nothing asks the server for it, so the counter screen is empty.
You load the stock, say what is happening, and move it into a hook.
Now the stock arrives, and a slow or broken network gets a plain message.
Same eight records, back on screen. And a dropped line says so.
